items.raw_excerpt: Irreplaceable research samples have been destroyed, experiments delayed and lab access cut off after a four-day power outage at Western University in London, Ont., left biology researchers scrambling to protect years of work.
items.summary_en: A four-day power outage at Western University in London, Ontario destroyed irreplaceable research samples and delayed experiments. Biology researchers rushed to protect years of work when lab access was cut off.

items.title_en: Western University lab loses samples after 4-day power outage

items.raw_excerpt: Calcutta High Court upholds Speaker's appointment of Ritabrata Banerjee as Leader of Opposition, amid internal Trinamool Congress dispute.
items.summary_en: The Calcutta High Court approved the appointment of Ritabrata Banerjee as Leader of Opposition in West Bengal. The decision was made during a dispute within the ruling party about who should hold the opposition position.

items.raw_excerpt: En el Mes de los Niños y las Niñas, "Creciendo Juntos" abre un espacio para conocer sus experiencias, preocupaciones y propuestas. En este capítulo, integrantes de los Consejos Consultivos de distintas comunas conversan con el subsecretario de la Niñez sobre la importancia de la participación infantil y el derecho de niños, niñas y adolescentes a ser escuchados.

items.raw_excerpt: Das 21. Zurich Film Festival beeindruckte mit internationalen Stars und einem historischen Schweizer Erfolg im Dokumentarfilm. Trendthema KI dominiert.
items.summary_en: The 21st Zurich Film Festival welcomed international stars and celebrated a historic Swiss victory in the documentary category. The festival also highlighted artificial intelligence as a key trend in filmmaking.

items.raw_excerpt: Las bases de la concesión establecen que el nuevo contrato tendrá una duración máxima de 50 años y requiere una inversión mínima de 20 millones de euros
items.summary_en: The Port of Tarragona has launched a public tender for the Moll d'Andalusia, a key dock terminal. The new concession contract will run for up to 50 years and requires a minimum investment of 20 million euros to expand container handling capacity.

items.title_original: El Port de Tarragona saca a licitación el Moll d’Andalusia para reforzar el tráfico de contenedores - Diari de Tarragona

items.raw_excerpt: Levantamento revela que o maior ganho do tempo integral chega principalmente aos estudantes mais vulneráveis: as 1.166 escolas 100% integrais com menor nível socioeconômico.
items.summary_en: A survey shows that full-time schooling brings the biggest benefits to Brazil's most vulnerable students. The study analyzed 1,166 schools with the lowest socioeconomic levels that operate 100% full-time. Results indicate these schools are helping close the education gap.
items.summary_ko: 전일제 수업이 브라질에서 가장 취약한 학생들에게 가장 큰 혜택을 주는 것으로 나타났다. 연구는 최저 사회경제 수준의 1,166개 전일제 학교를 분석했으며, 이 학교들이 교육 격차를 줄이는 데 기여하고 있는 것으로 확인되었다.
items.title_en: Natura Brazil Institute Analyzes 2025 IDEB Results for Full-Time Schools

items.raw_excerpt: Opening arguments are underway in a trial that pits four states against the company that owns Facebook and Instagram. They allege that Meta knew its products could hook kids — and lied about the danger.
items.summary_en: Four states are suing Meta, saying the company knew Facebook and Instagram harm children but lied about the risks. Opening arguments started Monday in the federal trial.

items.title_en: Child Safety Trial Against Meta Begins in Federal Court

items.summary_en: The Telangana government will provide cement at ₹230 per bag for Indiramma housing projects. The scheme aims to make home building more affordable for residents in the state. Prices are significantly lower than regular market rates.

items.raw_excerpt: The Government of the Azores is developing the Air Route Development Fund.
items.summary_en: The Azores regional government is creating a fund to attract new airline routes. The Air Route Development Fund aims to bring more direct flights to the islands. More routes could make travel easier for residents and tourists.

items.summary_en: Chilean authorities announced that visiting fans will be allowed to attend the Superclásico again. The decision came after a meeting held in May. It ends a long period when away supporters were banned from the famous derby matches.

items.raw_excerpt: Equipe da EM Jardim Santo Inácio recebeu o prefeito e o secretário da Educação liderados pelo estudante do 3º ano, Leonardo Gurski, que foi agradecer o início das obras da quadra da escola
items.summary_en: A student at Escola Santo Inácio in Curitiba led the mayor and education secretary on a tour to thank them for the sports court renovation. The school, which scored 8 on Brazil's IDEB education index, hosted the event to mark the project's start.

items.raw_excerpt: Tamil Nadu to establish a ₹5 crore Talent Research Wing to nurture future Olympic champions and enhance sports facilities.
items.summary_en: The Tamil Nadu state government plans to establish a Talent Research Wing with a budget of 5 crore rupees. The wing aims to discover and nurture young athletes who could become future Olympic champions. It will also work to improve sports facilities across the state.

items.raw_excerpt: Banks Peninsula's Okains Bay Museum has unveiled design plans for a major redevelopment the board says is essential to protect its precious displays.
items.summary_en: Okains Bay Museum on Banks Peninsula has revealed design plans for a large redevelopment project. The museum board says the upgrade is needed to protect its valuable displays. The project will transform the small community museum.

items.raw_excerpt: A scientific publication highlights international collaboration, continuous adaptation, and the contribution of this case to scientific knowledge about one of the marine species most difficult to monitor in a rehabilitation setting.
items.summary_en: A sea turtle was nursed back to health at a marine rehabilitation center in southern Portugal. The successful recovery highlights international collaboration in protecting one of the ocean's most difficult-to-monitor species. The turtle was released back into the waters off the Algarve coast.
items.summary_ko: 남부 포르투갈의 해양 재활 센터에서 바다거북이 건강을 회복한 후 바다로 돌아갔다. 이번 성공적인 구조는 바다에서 모니터링이 가장 어려운 종 중 하나인 바다거북 보호를 위한 국제 협력의 중요성을 보여준다. 거북이는 알가르브 해안으로 방류되었다.

items.raw_excerpt: Pyrography — or the craft of making art with fire — has been around for thousands of years. But a new generation of young artists is making the practice their own.
items.summary_en: Young Australian artists are rediscovering pyrography, the ancient craft of creating art by burning designs into wood and leather. A Gold Coast teacher stumbled into the practice when her mum asked her to draw on a cheese board. An Aboriginal artist from the Taungurung people is also using fire art to keep alive the tradition of decorating possum-skin cloaks.
items.summary_ko: 호주의 젊은 예술가들이 오래된 불그림 기법인 피로그라피를 새롭게 조명하고 있다. 골드코스트의 한 고등학교 교사는 엄마의 치즈 보드 요청을 계기로 이 예술을 시작했다. 타운거룽 출신의 원주민 예술가는 불그림으로 주머니 obtaining 담요 전통을 이어가고 있다.
items.title_en: The delicate and smoky art of painting with fire
items.title_ko: 불로 그림을 그리는 섬세한 예술
items.title_original: The delicate (and smoky) art of painting with fire

items.raw_excerpt: FolkFaro has returned to the Algarve, bringing traditional music, dance and costumes from seven countries to towns across the region.
items.summary_en: The FolkFaro festival has returned to the Algarve region of Portugal. It brings traditional music, dance, and costumes from seven different countries. The festival is being held in towns across the Algarve.

items.raw_excerpt: Irish shoppers will be hit with an additional €2 handling fee for items bought outside the EU.
items.summary_en: Ireland will charge a two euro handling fee on items bought from outside the European Union. The new rule aims to cover customs processing costs. Many online shoppers who buy from non-EU sellers will be affected.
